BC_description: The uuid.BufferClass property has been removed in version 2.0.0. This property was previously used to define or access a custom Buffer class for UUID operations, and its removal will cause runtime errors in client code that attempts to read from or write to uuid.BufferClass. This change affects any code relying on direct manipulation of the BufferClass property for buffer-related customization in the uuid library.
Adaptation_method: Stop accessing uuid.BufferClass. If custom buffer handling is required, implement it externally by wrapping UUID generation or using native Buffer methods directly. No direct replacement is provided by the library.
